blocks.text: Logged ₹1,200 on HSBC Live+ Credit Card: ₹120 reward. Caps updated.

msgs.what: Manual for now. Automatic capture comes from statements (M1) and bank notifications and Gmail alerts (M2).
With an idempotency key, so a double tap or retry logs once.
Stores amount, category, channel, reward and how much of each cap it used.
For cap counters and future cap-watch nudges.
The button turns into Logged; a second tap with the same key returns the same payment instead of logging twice.
